pinout.notes: Dual-die part: high-side + low-side MOSFET in one package; pinout is for the COMBO package.

id_conditions: Per die, T_J=25 C; derate above 25 C. Combo part — see datasheet table for high-side vs low-side specs.
typical_applications: Buck converter power stage for VCC_CORE
verification_notes: VDS, RDS_on, Qg, package and combo topology verified against TI datasheet. Combo part means a single component carries BOTH high-side and low-side FETs — do not treat as a single discrete FET.
replacement_notes: Combo PowerBlock parts are electrically equivalent only to another combo part with the same pinout and gate-drive compatibility. Replacing with two discretes requires board layout changes.
